batch.explain: Delay is the wait before sending that step. The first step sends immediately.
batch.name: Name

reply.explain: When received data matches, replies are sent in order. Each delay starts after the previous reply.
reply.name: Name
reply.hintTemplateHex: ?? matches any one byte, * matches any length; use \$1, \$2 in replies for the bytes they matched
reply.hintTemplateAscii: ? matches any one byte, * any length; \\? \\* \\r \\n \\xHH are literals; use \$1, \$2 in replies
reply.hintRegexHex: Matched against spaced uppercase HEX (e.g. A5 5A 03); write ^ and \$ yourself; use \$1, \$2 for groups
reply.hintRegexAscii: Matched against the raw bytes; write ^ and \$ yourself; use \$1, \$2 for groups

history.note: Only data sent with the Send button is recorded
history.fillHint: Time sends again · Fill puts it back in the box

calc.explain: CRC16 is MODBUS (low byte first). CRC32 is IEEE (big-endian). Append writes the checksum into the send box.

dialog.deleteQuick: Delete quick command "$name"? This cannot be undone.
dialog.deleteFolder: Delete folder "$name"? This cannot be undone.
dialog.deleteFolderWith: Delete folder "$name" and the $count commands in it? This cannot be undone.
dialog.deleteRule: Delete rule "$name"? This cannot be undone.
dialog.deleteBatch: Delete batch "$name"? This cannot be undone.
dialog.deleteHistory: Delete all $count history entries? This cannot be undone.
dialog.aboutBody: Device Debug Tools · serial console. Open a port to send and receive.
dialog.aboutDetail: Quick commands, batch send, and auto-reply do nothing while the port is closed. Incoming bytes are merged by the packet timeout. Checksums: SUM8, XOR/BCC, LRC, CRC8, CRC16 (MODBUS, low byte first), CRC32 (IEEE, big-endian).
dialog.keySend: Send (while the send box is focused)
dialog.keyQuick: Send the quick command bound to that key
dialog.keyStop: Stop repeat send and batch send
dialog.fileRaw: Any file type works (.bin, .dat, .txt, …). The file's raw bytes are sent as-is, with no encoding conversion.
dialog.fileText: Hex characters in a text file are not parsed: a .txt containing "01 02" sends the ASCII codes of those 5 characters. Use a binary file to send HEX data.
dialog.fileAppend: If "Append checksum" or "Append CR LF" is checked, it is added after the file data. Escape parsing and AT auto-CR do not apply to files.
dialog.fileWhole: The whole file is read into memory and written in one go, without splitting. Split large files yourself to avoid UI stalls while sending.
dialog.filePreview: While a file is loaded the send box is read-only and previews only the first $count bytes. Click "Remove" or the send box's "Clear" to leave file mode.
dialog.fileLoop: With "Repeat every" checked, the whole file is resent on each period.

validate.dupFolder: A folder with this name already exists
validate.badHex: HEX must be pairs of hex characters
validate.badPattern: Pattern must be HEX; characters other than ?? and * must come in pairs
validate.badReply: Reply $n must be HEX; \$1, \$2 may be inserted
validate.badCapture: Reply $n refers to capture $ref, but the pattern has only $count wildcards
validate.badDelay: Delay $n must be zero or greater
validate.badStepDelay: Delay $n must be zero or greater
